elena-sec: Quick question — auditor asked how we tag evidence items so they map back to incidents and control IDs. do we have a canonical field set?
rohan-eng: We use metadata in the S3 manifest: incident_id, control_id, evidence_type, collection_ts, collector_id. short names to keep object keys small.
jane-auditor: thx. can you show an example manifest line? auditor needs to match to their control matrix.
elena-sec: sure — example below (one line per artifact):
```
{"key":"evidence/2026-03-20/incident-243/role-change-logs.gz","incident_id":"INC-243","control_id":"AC-2.1","evidence_type":"k8s_audit_logs","collection_ts":"2026-03-20T15:12:03Z","collector_id":"log-exporter-v2","retention_days":"365"}
```
rohan-eng: note: we also add optional tags for "environment" and "deploy_id" when available.
sam-sre: auditor — when you say match to control matrix, do you want a CSV crosswalk? we can generate mapping: control_id -> list of S3 keys + presigned urls for sampling window.
jane-auditor: CSV fine. one ask: include a short human-friendly evidence description column and whether the artifact contains PII or prod data.
elena-sec: ack. we'll add evidence_description and data_sensitivity fields.
rohan-eng: operational note: for RBAC changes the source of truth is the infra repo commit + iam change ticket. we pull that commit hash into manifest as deploy_id.
jane-auditor: sample window: please provide 30-day sampling around the incident date and one rolling sample from last 90 days for baseline.
sam-sre: we have automated exports: `./scripts/export_evidence.sh --incident INC-243 --window 2026-03-01:2026-04-01 --format csv` — will generate CSV crosswalk + zipped artifacts.
elena-sec: also clarifying KMS metadata: do we need to include key IDs used to encrypt bundles? auditor asked for key provenance.
jane-auditor: yes include KMS key id and key policy reference if possible. we need chain-of-custody for encryption.
rohan-eng: we'll include kms_key_id and s3_server_side_encryption fields in manifest. for private deployments we keep HSM reference token.
sam-sre: about log retention proof: are screenshots of SIEM queries acceptable or do you need raw exports?
evidence-bot: automated export started for INC-243, job id job-20260320-77. status: exporting 42 artifacts. ETA ~3m. :gear:
jane-auditor: raw exports preferred but screenshots ok as supplement. presigned urls + checksums are ideal.
elena-sec: agreed. we'll add sha256 checksum for every artifact and include presigned_url_expiry_days.
rohan-eng: final checklist I propose to deliver: 1) CSV crosswalk with columns: s3_key, presigned_url, sha256, collection_ts, incident_id, control_id, evidence_type, evidence_description, data_sensitivity, kms_key_id, deploy_id. 2) zipped artifact bundle with index.json 3) chain-of-custody log (who exported + ticket ref).
jane-auditor: that works. can you deliver by EOD?
elena-sec: aiming for EOD. tagging follow-ups here. :thumbsup:
sam-sre: job-20260320-77 completed. uploaded to s3://redwood-audit-deliveries/INC-243/ — presigned urls attached in CSV.
jane-auditor: received. reviewing now, will ping with questions.
elena-sec: thanks — ping if any mismatches in control mapping.
